caption: The drawing is rendered in grayscale pencil on a light background and features a central, detailed depiction of a tankard with a curved, ornate handle and a flared base and rim. The body of the tankard is cylindrical, with a narrower neck and a rounded lower section above the pedestal base. Around the main drawing, within a rectangular border, are four smaller technical sketches in the corners: the upper left shows a side cross-section of the handle with a height measurement of 2 inches; the upper right shows a top view of the handle with a length measurement; the lower left shows a small end view of the handle; and the lower right shows a front profile of the tankard with width and height measurements labeled as "4" and "6 3/4." At the bottom center is a horizontal scale labeled "Scale 5 in. 1/2." The drawing uses fine, precise lines for detail and shading, and the entire composition is presented with clear annotations for dimensions and proportions.
title: Pewter Mug
